_purpose: Provenance record for the immutable raw Alpaca capture in this directory. This file describes ONLY the raw quote CSV; the normalized/derived dataset has its own manifest at datasets/historical/AAPL_2024-01-03_0930-1030ET.manifest.json.
source: Alpaca Markets historical market data API, via the alpaca-py Python SDK (StockHistoricalDataClient.get_stock_quotes / StockQuotesRequest)
timezone: UTC (raw timestamps); equivalent to America/New_York 09:30:00-10:30:00 EST (market was on standard time; session is NOT during US DST)
data_types_not_acquired: historical trades - NOT acquired. No ALPACA_API_KEY/ALPACA_SECRET_KEY were available in the environment that performed this Phase 2 integration, and that environment's network egress allowlist does not include Alpaca's API host, so historical-execution/download_trades.py (added in this phase) could not be executed. It is written and ready to run wherever real credentials + network access exist.
OHLC bars - deliberately not used per the Phase 2 objective (quotes/trades only)
L2/L3 order book depth - Alpaca's historical data API does not provide venue depth beyond NBBO top-of-book
actual_feed: IEX (DataFeed.IEX in the request). Verified from the raw data itself, not assumed: every row's bid_exchange/ask_exchange field is 'V' (IEX's MIC) and every row's tape field is 'C' (Tape C / Nasdaq-listed). This is Alpaca's free-tier feed - a single-venue view, NOT the consolidated SIP NBBO across all exchanges. Do not describe this dataset as SIP data.
conditions_observed: Every raw quote carries condition code 'R' (Regular) - no other quote condition codes appear in this capture.
retrieval_timestamp: Not captured. download_quotes.py (as it existed when this raw file was produced, prior to this Phase 2 pass) did not log a retrieval timestamp. This is a real, disclosed gap - the file's filesystem mtime is NOT a reliable substitute (it reflects when the file was last copied/extracted in a given environment, not when it was downloaded from Alpaca). historical-execution/download_quotes.py should be extended to print/log a UTC retrieval timestamp on every future run; this has not been done retroactively for this already-acquired file.
request_id: Not available. The alpaca-py SDK's StockHistoricalDataClient.get_stock_quotes() returns a parsed DataFrame (quotes.df) and does not expose the underlying HTTP response's request-id header through its public API used by download_quotes.py/test_alpaca.py. No request ID was captured.
immutability: This raw CSV is never modified after acquisition. All cleaning, filtering, resampling, and schema conversion happens downstream in historical-execution/normalize.py, whose output is a separate file under data/normalized/ and datasets/historical/, each with its own manifest.
